description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between translation quality, measured by BLEU (Bilingual Evaluation Understudy), and latency, measured by Average Lagging (AL), in a Wait-info Policy for machine translation. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)," is a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 10.0, with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU," is also a linear scale ranging from 18 to 28, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot includes four lines, each representing a different combination of consistency and model type. The "Consistency-CE" line is represented by a purple dotted line with circle markers, the "Inconsistency-CE" line by a purple dashed line with square markers, the "Inconsistency-CE-MP" line by a blue dashed line with square markers, and the "Consistency-Bi" line by a red solid line with star markers. The "Consistency-CE" line starts at approximately 20 BLEU at 0.0 AL and ends at around 26 BLEU at 10.0 AL. The "Inconsistency-CE" line starts at about 20 BLEU at 0.0 AL and ends at approximately 27 BLEU at 10.0 AL. The "Inconsistency-CE-MP" line starts at around 20 BLEU at 0.0 AL and ends at about 27 BLEU at 10.0 AL. The "Consistency-Bi" line starts at approximately 22 BLEU at 0.0 AL and ends at around 28 BLEU at 10.0 AL. The plot shows that as latency increases, translation quality also tends to increase for all combinations, with the "Consistency-Bi" combination achieving the highest translation quality at the highest latency.
